name: KeypadLinc
description: The KeypadLinc code base used by the 6- and 8-button KeypadLinc dimmer and relay keypads, including the 2334 and 2487S keypads. Most extended settings are per button.

enumerations.name: manualChangeDirection
enumerations.description: Which way a manual change moves the level.

enumerations.name: triggerLevel
enumerations.description: Which level a triggered group sets the local load to.

enumerations.name: triggerRampRate
enumerations.description: How fast a triggered group changes the local load.

values.name: localRampRate
values.description: At the local load's ramp rate.

valueTables.name: rampRate
valueTables.description: How long each ramp rate takes to go from off to full on.

valueTables.name: onOff
valueTables.description: Off and on, for a load or LED a record switches.

operatingFlags.name: programmingLock
operatingFlags.label: Programming lock
operatingFlags.description: Linking and programming from the device itself are locked out.

operatingFlags.name: ledOnTransmit
operatingFlags.label: Blink LED when sending
operatingFlags.description: The status LED blinks when the device sends an Insteon message.

operatingFlags.name: resumeDim
operatingFlags.label: Resume dim
operatingFlags.description: Turning the load on at the device restores its last level instead of the on-level.

operatingFlags.name: eightButtons
operatingFlags.label: Eight-button layout
operatingFlags.description: The keypad has the 8-button layout. When the bit is 0, it has the 6-button layout.

verification.note: One source swaps 0x06 and 0x07 (the 6- and 8-button layouts) and 0x08 and 0x09 (backlight on and off); the values here are those other sources give.

operatingFlags.name: ledOff
operatingFlags.label: LED off
operatingFlags.description: The status LEDs and button backlights are off.

verification.note: The Insteon Developer's Guide reads bit 4 of the 0x00 reply as LED on, but later sources read it as LED off, the state 0x08 sets.

operatingFlags.name: keyBeep
operatingFlags.label: Beep on button press
operatingFlags.description: The device beeps when a button is pressed.

operatingFlags.name: radioOff
operatingFlags.label: Turn off radio
operatingFlags.description: The device doesn't originate RF messages. It still repeats the RF messages it hears.

operatingFlags.name: powerLineOff
operatingFlags.label: Turn off powerline
operatingFlags.description: Insteon communication over the powerline is off. The device turns it back on whenever it powers up.

operatingFlags.name: applicationRetries
operatingFlags.label: Application retries
operatingFlags.description: The device retries application messages as many times as its ALL-Link database says, and reports cleanup errors.

operatingFlags.name: x10Off
operatingFlags.label: Turn off X10
operatingFlags.description: X10 sending and receiving are off.

operatingFlags.name: errorBlink
operatingFlags.label: Blink LED on errors
operatingFlags.description: The status LED blinks when a communication error occurs.

operatingFlags.name: cleanupReport
operatingFlags.label: Send cleanup reports
operatingFlags.description: The device sends a success report after the cleanup messages that follow a group command.

operatingFlags.name: checksumRequired
operatingFlags.label: Require checksums
operatingFlags.description: Extended Set and ALL-Link database write messages must carry a checksum in D14.

operatingFlags.name: detachedLoad
operatingFlags.label: Detach load from buttons
operatingFlags.description: The load is detached from button 1 and is controlled as group 9. It can only be set by software.

operatingFlags.name: smartHops
operatingFlags.label: Smart hops
operatingFlags.description: Each message starts with the hop count of the last acknowledgment received (smart hops). When the bit is 0, each message starts with one hop.

readings.name: databaseDelta
readings.label: ALL-Link database changes
readings.description: A count that goes up whenever the ALL-Link database changes.

readings.name: crcErrorCount
readings.label: CRC errors
readings.description: The number of messages received with a CRC error.

verification.note: The Insteon Developer's Guide gives query 0x02 as a signal-to-noise value; later sources count messages with CRC errors there.

readings.name: triggerMask
readings.label: Buttons that trigger another device's group
readings.description: The trigger buttons, one bit per button with button 1 in bit 0. Each sends a trigger command when pressed.

flagCommands.name: yakityYakOff
flagCommands.description: Turns the Yakity Yak signaling option off.

flagCommands.name: yakityYakOn
flagCommands.description: Turns the Yakity Yak signaling option on.

flagCommands.name: modSyncFailureNoHop
flagCommands.description: When modulation sync fails, the device doesn't hop the message.

flagCommands.name: modSyncFailureOwnZeroCrossing
flagCommands.description: When modulation sync fails, the device uses its own zero crossing.

flagCommands.name: pushHopsToRadioOn
flagCommands.description: The device repeats every powerline hop over RF.

flagCommands.name: pushHopsToRadioOff
flagCommands.description: The device doesn't repeat every powerline hop over RF.

values.name: onMask
values.label: Buttons that turn on with this one
values.description: The buttons that turn on with this button.

values.name: offMask
values.label: Buttons that turn off with this one
values.description: The buttons that turn off when this button is pressed.

values.name: x10HouseCode
values.label: X10 house code
values.description: The X10 house code, or 0x20 for no X10 address.

values.name: rampRate
values.label: Ramp rate
values.description: The ramp rate, from 0x01 (8 minutes) to 0x1F (0.1 second). 0x00 is 2 seconds.

verification.note: Earlier sources give ramp rate 0x00 as 9 minutes; the table uses the later reading, 2 seconds.

values.name: onLevel
values.label: On-level
values.description: The level the load turns on to, from 0x00 (off) to 0xFF (full).

values.name: ledBrightness
values.label: LED brightness
values.description: The brightness of the status LEDs, from 0x11 (dimmest) to 0x7F (brightest).

values.name: nonToggleMask
values.label: Buttons that send one command
values.description: The non-toggle buttons, which send the same command on every press.

values.name: ledMask
values.label: LEDs that are on
values.description: The buttons whose LEDs are on.

values.name: x10AllMask
values.label: Buttons that send X10 all on and off
values.description: The buttons that send X10 All On or All Off instead of On or Off.

values.name: nonToggleOnMask
values.label: Non-toggle buttons that send on
values.description: The non-toggle buttons that send On. The others send Off.

values.name: groupMask
values.label: Radio-button groups
values.description: The buttons in a radio group with this button. The group only works when the off mask holds them too.

writes.name: onMask
writes.description: Sets the on mask of button D1.

writes.name: offMask
writes.description: Sets the off mask (D3) and radio group (D4) of button D1. The radio group only works when the off mask holds it too.

writes.name: x10Address
writes.description: Sets the X10 address of button D1.

writes.name: rampRate
writes.description: Sets the ramp rate of button D1. With the load detached, bit 6 makes buttons 2 through 8 control only their LEDs, and bit 7 the load and LED.

writes.name: onLevel
writes.description: Sets the on-level of button D1.

writes.name: ledBrightness
writes.description: Sets the brightness of the status LEDs.

writes.name: ledMask
writes.description: Turns the button LEDs on and off.

writes.name: x10AllMask
writes.description: Sets which buttons send X10 All On or All Off.

writes.name: nonToggleOnMask
writes.description: Sets which non-toggle buttons send On.

writes.name: triggerMask
writes.description: Sets which buttons are trigger buttons.

writes.name: maxRetries
writes.description: Sets how many times the device retries a message, from 0x01 to 0xFF. 0x00 restores the factory default of 5.

standardCommands.name: lightOn
standardCommands.description: Turns the load on to the level in cmd2 at the saved ramp rate.

parameter.name: onLevel
parameter.description: The level to go to, from 0x00 (off) to 0xFF (full).

standardCommands.name: lightOnFast
standardCommands.description: Turns the load on to the level in cmd2 instantly.

parameter.name: onLevel
parameter.description: The level to go to, from 0x00 (off) to 0xFF (full).

standardCommands.name: lightOff
standardCommands.description: Turns the load off at the saved ramp rate. The device ignores cmd2.

standardCommands.name: lightOffFast
standardCommands.description: Turns the load off instantly. The device ignores cmd2.

standardCommands.name: brightenOneStep
standardCommands.description: Brightens the load one step of 32 from off to full. The device ignores cmd2.

standardCommands.name: dimOneStep
standardCommands.description: Dims the load one step of 32 from off to full. The device ignores cmd2.

standardCommands.name: startManualChange
standardCommands.description: Starts brightening or dimming the load until a stop manual change command.

parameter.name: direction
parameter.description: Which way to change the level.

standardCommands.name: stopManualChange
standardCommands.description: Stops a manual change. The device ignores cmd2.

standardCommands.name: readStatus
standardCommands.description: Reads the load's level. The acknowledgment's cmd1 carries the ALL-Link database delta.

standardCommands.name: readLeds
standardCommands.description: Reads which button LEDs are on. The acknowledgment's cmd1 carries the ALL-Link database delta.

reply.name: leds
reply.description: The LEDs that are on, with button 1 in bit 0.

standardCommands.name: readTargetLevel
standardCommands.description: Reads the level the load is moving to.

reply.name: targetLevel
reply.description: The level the load is moving to, or its level if it isn't moving.

standardCommands.name: instantChange
standardCommands.description: Sets the load to the level in cmd2 instantly.

parameter.name: onLevel
parameter.description: The level to go to, from 0x00 (off) to 0xFF (full).

standardCommands.name: onAtRampRate
standardCommands.description: Turns the load on to a level at a ramp rate, both given in cmd2.

parameter.name: levelAndRampRate
parameter.description: Bits 4 through 7 give the level, which is 16 times their value plus 0x0F, and bits 0 through 3 the ramp rate, which is 2 times their value plus 1.

standardCommands.name: offAtRampRate
standardCommands.description: Turns the load off at a ramp rate given in cmd2. Bits 4 through 7 are 0.

parameter.name: rampRate
parameter.description: The ramp rate, which is 2 times this value plus 1.

standardCommands.name: beep
standardCommands.description: Beeps once, as pressing the SET button does. The device ignores cmd2.

extendedCommands.name: triggerGroup
extendedCommands.description: Sends group D1's command to the group as if its button were pressed, and sets the local load as D2 through D6 say. The device doesn't parse the command it sends, so to turn the local load off, put 0x01 in D2 and 0x00 in D3.

parameters.name: levelSource
parameters.description: Which level the local load goes to.

parameters.name: onLevel
parameters.description: The level the local load goes to when D2 is 0x01.

parameters.name: groupCommand1
parameters.description: The cmd1 to send to the group.

parameters.name: groupCommand2
parameters.description: The cmd2 to send to the group.

parameters.name: rampRate
parameters.description: How fast the local load changes.

responder.name: onLevel
responder.label: On-level
responder.description: The level the group goes to when its controller's On arrives, 0x00 (off) to 0xFF (full). 0x00 makes the link off only.

responder.name: rampRate
responder.label: Ramp rate
responder.description: How fast the group goes to its on-level.

responder.name: button
responder.label: Button
responder.description: The button the record is for: 0x01, or 0x09 for the detached load.

verification.note: The KeypadLinc Line Developer Notes give buttons 0x01 to 0x08; 0x09 for the detached load, group 9, is read from the group's number, as no document describes it.

responder.name: onLevel
responder.label: On or off
responder.description: 0x00 turns the load off when the controller's On arrives, 0xFF on.

responder.name: rampRate
responder.label: Ramp rate
responder.description: The ramp rate; an on/off keypad switches at once.

responder.name: button
responder.label: Button
responder.description: The button the record is for: 0x01, or 0x09 for the detached load.

verification.note: The KeypadLinc Line Developer Notes give buttons 0x01 to 0x08; 0x09 for the detached load, group 9, is read from the group's number, as no document describes it.
No document says that every nonzero level means on; the ranges are read from Light Status Request's level byte (cmd2), as the Insteon Developer's Guide describes it for on/off devices.

responder.name: onLevel
responder.label: LED
responder.description: Whether the button's LED turns on (0xFF) or off (0x00) when its controller's On arrives.

verification.note: Read from the KeypadLinc Line Developer Notes' records, whose Data 1 is the on-level, which for a button is its LED.

responder.name: button
responder.label: Button
responder.description: The button the record is for, 0x02 to 0x08.

verification.note: The KeypadLinc Line Developer Notes give buttons 0x01 to 0x08.

notes: Earlier sources give ramp rates 0x00 through 0x1F as 9 minutes down to 0.1 second; the later ones make 0x01 8 minutes and 0x00 2 seconds.

Earlier sources, the Insteon Developer's Guide and the KeypadLinc Line Developer Notes give D14 of the reply as the trigger mask; later sources moved the trigger mask to query 0x08 and use D14 for the radio group mask.
The Insteon Developer's Guide sets selectors 0x08 through 0x0C one button at a time; other sources write the whole mask.
The KeypadLinc Line Developer Notes cover firmware 0x41 and later of subcategories 0x1B, 0x1C, 0x0F, 0x1E and 0x2C, and every firmware of 0x41 and 0x42.
In the 6-button layout, the On and Off buttons are group 1 and the four small buttons groups 3 through 6; in the 8-button layout, the buttons are groups 1 through 8.

With the load detached, group 9 controls the load: cmd1 0x19 with cmd2 0x00 reads its level, D11 of the extended Get reply holds the LEDs of groups 1 through 8, a group 1 On or Off sets the group 1 LEDs, and the LED mask Set sets the others.

To make buttons act as radio buttons, set both the on mask and the off mask of each button to the other buttons in the group, and link each button as a controller with an off-only link (on-level 0x00) to the devices the other buttons control.
